expect_red: a nav row that has both a description and an alert mark offers ONE hover surface per target: the name's tooltip and the mark's card, never a native tooltip stacked under the card

mutations.contract: A nav row offers one hover surface per thing a pointer can rest on. The description belongs to the NAME; the alert mark opens a card and says nothing natively while it can.
mutations.note: The defect Jeff reported was the ROW's title showing through the mark's card -- two levels above the pixel the pointer was on -- so the mutation puts it back exactly where it was rather than on the mark. A guard that only looked at the mark would stay green on this. Re-anchored 2026-11-10 (the_model_is_derived_once_and_the_left_column_is_its_tree): the stack row left the rail for the picker, so the ROW title goes back onto a study row, the one row with a description and a mark now.
